notes.title: Star Seeker in: The BIG ADVENTURE EVENT
notes.content:
We're excited to be part of The Big Adventure Event, presented by Hitcents- a celebration of adventure games from all over! 80+ games, 40+ demos, live broadcasts, and more! (Star Seeker's gonna be on sale, too.) 

Check out @hitcents and #theBAE on Twitter for more info!

notes.title: Demo Livestream for Star Seeker in: the Secret of the Sorcerous Standoff
notes.content: We've just released a free demo of Star Seeker in: the Secret of the Sorcerous Standoff, and the developer (Benedict Ide) will be streaming a playthrough. Of course, the demo's pretty short, so we'll also be showing off a bit of the beginning of the full game, as a sneak preview.
